subject: Mutual Transit MAP & Onboarding Sprint Calendar
messages:
From: Samira Khan <skhan@aurorahealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyanka Singh <psingh@aurorahealth.com>, Aurora Health IT <it@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff + proposed timeline

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency profile and the routing/fallback ideas. We want to start formalizing the MAP so procurement, IT, and our product team all have clear milestones.

Quick context: Aurora Health is planning phased rollout of Redwood inference into two products (PatientMessaging and ClinicianSearch). Primary constraints: SOC2 evidence for data retention, a staging window for integration tests (2 weeks), and a soft go-live target around the week of 2026-07-06.

Could you share a short mutual action plan with milestone owners, dates, and the minimal acceptance criteria for each stage? I attached a short list of internal requirements (Aurora_Onboarding_Reqs.pdf).

High-level asks from our side:
- Alignment on model variant for PatientMessaging (latency priority)
- KV cache and prefix caching behavior during migration
- Admin access for our infra team during staging

Appreciate a draft this week if possible — Priyanka will coordinate procurement and will loop in our security lead if we need artifacts.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Product Integrations | Aurora Health
[attachment: Aurora_Onboarding_Reqs.pdf]
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Priyanka Singh <psingh@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Mutual Transit MAP & Onboarding Sprint Calendar

Samira — thanks for the clear context and the attachment. I put together a lightweight MAP draft and a sprint calendar (MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx) that maps owners, milestones, acceptance criteria, and a proposed cadence for the staging window. Key highlights below; full workbook attached.

Summary (high level):
- Week 0 (2026-05-18 — 2026-05-22): Kickoff + environment provisioning (Redwood Dedicated staging pool). Owner: Kimberly Park (Customer Success). Acceptance: staging GPU pool accessible from Aurora VPC; initial model artifact verified.
- Week 2 (2026-05-25 — 2026-06-05): Integration + prefix/KV caching validation. Owner: Ben Carter (Solutions Engineering). Acceptance: end-to-end requests hit expected latency budget (<120ms p50 for PatientMessaging), KV cache warm/replay tests pass.
- Week 4 (2026-06-08 — 2026-06-19): Security/compliance evidence exchange and pre-prod dry-run. Owner: Marissa Cole (CS / Compliance Liaison). Acceptance: SOC2 artifacts queued; retention policy confirmed; audit log export validated.
- Week 8 (2026-06-29 — 2026-07-03): Soft go-live window for PatientMessaging (canary 10% traffic). Owner: Tessa Morgan (Eng Ops). Acceptance: error rate <1% and fallbacks behave as designed.
- Post go-live (2026-07-06 — ongoing): Scale and handoff to Support/POC. Owner: Aurora product + Redwood CS. Acceptance: KPI tracking enabled in Console, weekly check-ins for 30 days.

Open items I want internal owners to confirm:
1) Ben — can you confirm the exact model checkpoint and quantization level we recommend for PatientMessaging?
2) Marissa — can you confirm which SOC2 artifacts we should provision first (system description, control matrix, logs)?
3) Priyanka/P&A — procurement constraints for contract milestone payments and any purchase order deadlines?

I tried to keep dates conservative to give your infra team two weeks for staging prep. If that looks tight we can move Week 0 out by one week.

Next steps: I’ll schedule a 30-min alignment call for Thursday so owners and Aurora can confirm the timeline; Ben and Marissa — can you review the attached worksheet and reply with comments by Wednesday EOD?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx]
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <skhan@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Transit MAP & Onboarding Sprint Calendar

Kimberly / Samira — reviewed the MAP_DRAFT_v1 and left inline notes on the Integration tab. A few clarifications from engineering/solutions side:

- Model variant: recommend using rdx-llama-13b-q4_1 (quantized) for PatientMessaging to save tokens while keeping latency within budget; fallback to rdx-llama-13b-fp16 for high-quality fallbacks.
- KV cache policy: we should enable prefix caching for frequently used templates and a 48-hour KV retention during staging to simulate production behavior.
- Staging infra: we can provision a 2xV100 pool for the first phase; if Aurora prefers TPU or different instance class, we'll need to reconvene with infra — that would add 4 business days to provisioning.

Action items I commit to:
- Create an integration checklist (post-request: sample curl tests, trace examples) by Wed 2026-04-29.
- Run an initial latency smoke test and share token-level breakdowns by Thu 2026-04-30.

One risk to call out: if procurement needs a purchase order signed before provisioning starts we should queue procurement earlier — otherwise we can start with a time-limited dev pool under our Dedicated trial.

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <skhan@aurorahealth.com>, Priyanka Singh <psingh@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Transit MAP & Onboarding Sprint Calendar

Thanks all — I added a Compliance & Evidence tab to MAP_DRAFT_v1 with the initial SOC2 artifacts we can share and the timeline for each. Quick summary:

- Week 3 deliverables: System Description, Control Matrix (redacted), and sample audit logs (redacted). Owner: Marissa Cole.
- We will produce an external-facing one-page security brief for Aurora's procurement/legal (to speed PO approvals). Owner: Marissa Cole. ETA: 2026-05-12.
- Retention policy confirmation: we propose 90-day log retention for soft-go-live; Aurora can request longer for specific datasets.

Also flagged in the workbook: acceptance criteria for the pre-prod dry-run must include an automated smoke test (passed 3/3) and successful run of the end-to-end user flow with synthetic data (no PHI).

Note on escalation: if the audit log export doesn't match Aurora's schema we'll open an action ticket with Eng and propose a 48-hour patch window during the dry-run.

I can take point on the 1-pager and the initial SOC2 packet — Kimberly, I’ll need a short intro from Aurora legal for distribution. Priyanka — can you confirm who on your legal/procurement team I should send this to?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Success (Compliance Liaison) | Redwood Inference
[attachment referenced: Compliance_1pager_draft.pdf]

Date: Mon, 03 May 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Transit MAP & Onboarding Sprint Calendar

All — this looks good and thanks for the quick turnaround. Priyanka confirms procurement can issue an initial PO by 2026-05-10 if we receive the 1-pager and the proposed SOW milestones by EOD 2026-05-07.

We accept the proposed Week 0 provisioning window but please keep me posted if Ben needs Aurora to provision any firewall rules or IP allowlists; I'll loop in IT once you confirm the exact ranges.

Next steps (agreed):
- Kimberly: schedule Thu 2026-05-06 30-min alignment call (owners + Aurora leads).
- Ben: deliver integration checklist + latency smoke results by 2026-04-30 (per your note).
- Marissa: deliver security 1-pager & SOC2 packet by 2026-05-12 (procurement will review the 1-pager earlier).

We’ll plan to start the staging window on 2026-05-18 assuming PO or trial provisioning is in place. Thank you — excited to get started.

Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Product Integrations | Aurora Health
